description: N5/C2 exact-diff review: derived activity domain module

no_authority_confusion.instructions: This module has no path by which a derived activity record can become authoritative healthcare state or mutate source-domain state

criteria.true: The module only derives and reads records, holds no domain-store handle, and offers no write-back
criteria.false: Some path lets a record become or change authoritative domain state

no_hidden_write_path.instructions: No hidden or indirect write path exists from this module back into a source domain

criteria.true: No import, callback, effect or side channel in the module writes outside its own store
criteria.false: An indirect mechanism in the module could write outside its own store

cross_tenant_isolation.instructions: No cross-tenant projection or read can succeed through this module

criteria.true: Tenant scope is checked on write and on every read, and a foreign record is unreachable
criteria.false: A caller can write into or read from a tenant it does not belong to

replay_determinism.instructions: Redelivery of the same canonical event is deterministic and cannot duplicate or silently rewrite activity history

criteria.true: The dedupe key and the content fingerprint together make a replay idempotent and a divergent replay an explicit error
criteria.false: A replay can duplicate history, or a divergent replay can overwrite or silently pass

stale_authority.instructions: Historical agent activity can never read as current authority after suspension, revocation, expiry or sponsor loss

criteria.true: Authority state is recorded at projection time and re-checked against the live registry before authority is implied
criteria.false: A stale record can be read as a live grant

payload_no_phi_or_secret.instructions: No realistic input can store prose, a clinical narrative, a direct patient identifier or credential material in an activity record through this module

criteria.true: The reference minting, the token shape rules, the closed payload vocabulary and the secret patterns together close the realistic vectors
criteria.false: A realistic input still reaches storage as prose, an identifier or a secret

residual_correctness_risk.instructions: How much residual correctness or security risk remains in this module as written
